title: Observation of Gas Exchange in the Middle Ear
brief_summary:
Observation of fluid behavior over a perforated eardrum.

A comparison of the behavior of the gas in normal vs. different kinds of otitis media ears.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients having perforated eardrum.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non cooperative patients.
study_population: Patients treated as a routine treatment in the outpatient or patients admitted for treatment of sudden hearing loss.
